# RHEL 8 GCC Toolset 12 Toolchain v1.0.0

Stable 1.0.0 release of the Linux x86_64 RHEL 8 compatibility toolchain.

## Highlights

- GCC 12.4 compiler and modern C++20 headers from conda-forge.
- glibc 2.28 sysroot baseline.
- RHEL 8 / GCC 8-era shared `libstdc++.so.6` and `libgcc_s.so.1`.
- GCC Toolset 12 `libstdc++_nonshared.a` for newer C++ implementation pieces without raising the shared GLIBCXX ceiling.
- Reproducible inputs through an explicit conda lock, pinned AlmaLinux RPMs, and a pinned micromamba bootstrap.

Release ABI policy:

```text
GLIBC   <= 2.28
GLIBCXX <= 3.4.25
CXXABI  <= 1.3.11
GCC ABI <= 7.0.0
```

## Compiler activation model

Activation deliberately does **not** replace the user's `gcc`, `g++`, or normal `PATH` command resolution. The original conda-forge target-prefixed compiler binaries under `$CONDA_PREFIX/bin` are also left untouched.

The compatibility layer is selected through compiler environment variables:

```text
CC
CXX
CPP
GCC
GXX
CC_FOR_BUILD
CXX_FOR_BUILD
```

These variables point to target-prefixed wrappers under `$CONDA_PREFIX/libexec/rhel8-gcc-toolset12/bin`. Binutils variables such as `AR`, `AS`, and `LD` remain the normal conda-forge target-prefixed tools.

The activation layer removes only the conda prefix runtime RPATH from `LDFLAGS`; `-rpath-link` and `-L` build-time search paths remain intact.

## Install with micromamba

```bash
micromamba create -y -n rhel8-gcc-toolset12 \
  --override-channels \
  -c https://edgeatzero.github.io/rhel8-gcc-toolset12-toolchain/conda \
  -c conda-forge \
  --strict-channel-priority \
  rhel8-gcc-toolset12-toolchain=1.0.0

micromamba activate rhel8-gcc-toolset12
```

Published conda package builds:

```text
rhel8-gcc-toolset12-compat      1.0.0 build 1
rhel8-gcc-toolset12-activate    1.0.0 build 3
rhel8-gcc-toolset12-toolchain   1.0.0 build 2
```

## GitHub Action

Exact release:

```yaml
- uses: EdgeAtZero/rhel8-gcc-toolset12-toolchain@v1.0.0
```

Stable v1 channel:

```yaml
- uses: EdgeAtZero/rhel8-gcc-toolset12-toolchain@v1
```

## Distribution

The GitHub Release is intentionally source-only. The assembled third-party GCC/binutils/glibc/sysroot runtime toolchain is not attached as a Release asset. The public conda channel installs the compatibility packages while obtaining the pinned conda-forge dependencies from their original channel.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/EdgeAtZero/rhel8-gcc-toolset12-toolchain/commits/v1.0.0
